name: documint
description: DocuMint interactive HTML or Markdown documentation with chat format selection and original viewer; no MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Say Use DocuMint to choose HTML, Markdown or Both. Generate downloadable documentation from authorized source using original embedded DocuMint Local HTML viewer assets and source-grounded Markdown. Selection is conversational because a skill-only plugin cannot force clickable ChatGPT checkboxes; downloads depend on host file tools.
defaultPrompt: Use DocuMint to generate HTML documentation for these files.
Use DocuMint to generate both HTML and Markdown.

publication.release_notes: DocuMint v0.3.1 adds short-prompt activation, conversational HTML/Markdown/Both selection, original embedded HTML viewer, and source-grounded Markdown. No MCP server.
